<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="שבט_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518916442_theRebbe_16" batchId="meluket-_D7_A9_D7_91_D7_98_meluket__BH_POST_1766518916442_theRebbe_16__p007">
  <section v="18">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Asterisks indicate a break in the text.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">* * *</t>
  </section>
  <section v="19">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>At a farbrengen on Shabbos Parshas Va'eira, 3 Shevat 1970, the Rebbe announced the completion of the Sefer Torah in the coming days.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">At the farbrengen of Shabbos Parshas Va'eira,</t>
    <t s="1">3 Shevat,</t>
    <t s="2">5730 (1970), the Rebbe shlita announced its completion in the coming days.</t>
    <t s="3">And this is the text of the sicha said at the time of its completion:</t>
  </section>
  <section v="20">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>It was desired that the completion of the Sefer Torah, which the Rebbe's father-in-law began writing, should coincide with the end of the twenty-year period since his passing.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">"For various reasons, it was desired</t>
    <t s="1">that the completion of the Sefer Torah, which my revered father-in-law, the Rebbe, began writing, should be at the conclusion of the twenty-year period since his passing.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
